elements.text:
You just turned in an important paper. As you're checking your submission, you notice you made an embarrassing typo in the first sentence

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I want to replay the moment of hitting submit over and over, but redirect my attention to something else instead.
I check if resubmitting the essay is possible.
I feel the urge to bring it up to my teacher preemptively, but decide to wait and see if it even comes up.
I make a note to proofread the opening sentence first next time and move on.
I email my teacher immediately with a panicked explanation before they've even read it.
